items.text:
I am obsessed with this game.  It scratches every inch of what I like in games.  Exploration, building, looting, commerce, all of it is there.  The UI is a bit off putting, the learning curve is there but it's not too steep.  Play the first few characters with the expectation that you will fail, and learn from what you did wrong.  Docking mini-game does become easier with practice.  TLDR:  It's a heck of a lot of fun and has taken up lots of my free time in the past week.  Highly recommend!

Wishlist:
Social:
I'd like to see the social aspects improved (it's a little murky what I'm doing sometimes) and it is a necessary part of the game to interact with.  I can't see both my own social stats and the person I am interacting with at the same time.  So I have to click on myself, see what needs are low (Intimacy, Contact, Family, etc.) and then back to the person I'm talking to.  It's a bit cumbersome.  

Orders & inventory:
Maybe there is already a way to do this, but when I send my character to uninstall large amounts of things they uninstall and drop them on the floor even if there is space in my inventory.  I'd like uninstall to automatically go into my pack or dolly by default with a way to turn that off if possible.  I saw something about Haul zones somewhere but I haven't been able to find it again.

Repair Priority:
I'd like to see repairs go by priority of need rather than proximity, especially if there is a collision and it causes a pressure, leak.  again, maybe that's already in the game but I'm not sure how to set it up if it is.
items.text_zh:
我对这款游戏着迷了。它满足了我对游戏喜好的每一个方面。探索、建造、搜刮、贸易，全都在那里。用户界面有点让人望而却步，学习曲线是有的，但不算太陡峭。玩前几个角色时就抱着你会失败的心态，并从你犯的错误中学习。对接小游戏确实会随着练习变得更容易。长话短说：它超级好玩，在过去一周里占用了我大量的空闲时间。强烈推荐！

愿望清单：
社交：
我希望看到社交方面得到改进（有时候我在做什么有点模糊不清），而且与它互动是游戏的必要部分。我无法同时看到我自己的社交属性和我正在互动的人。所以我必须点击我自己，看看哪些需求低（亲密、联系、家庭等），然后再切回我正在交谈的人。这有点麻烦。

订单与库存：
也许已经有办法做到这一点，但当我派我的角色卸载大量物品时，它们会卸载并把东西丢在地上，即使我的库存里有空间。我希望卸载默认自动进入我的背包或推车，如果可能的话，有一个可以关闭这个功能的选项。我在某处看到过关于搬运区的东西，但我一直没能再找到它。

维修优先级：
我希望看到维修按需求优先级而不是按距离来进行，尤其是在发生碰撞并导致压力、泄漏的情况下。再说一次，也许游戏里已经有了，但如果是的话，我不确定该如何设置。

observations.description: 修理按距离而非需求优先级进行
observations.evidence: I'd like to see repairs go by priority of need rather than proximity, especially if there is a collision and it causes a pressure, leak.
observations.evidence_zh: 我希望维修能按需求的优先级来进行，而不是按距离远近，尤其是在发生碰撞并导致失压、泄漏的时候。
